page.layout: One page of text, single column. Running head at top left, page number at top right. No marginal notes. Catchword at bottom right.

main_text.l: Thomas Comberus J. Morino, De exem-
plari quodam M. S. Pent. Samarit,

l.i: Reverende admodum D. Vir Clarissime Doctissimeque.

main_text.l: CUm rescissem partim ex fama, ad nos
per librarios perlata, partim ex prae-
siis à vobis adornari, avide sane aures
rari jam coeptam eidem accessuram esse,
equidem serio gaudebam. Dabit ea res
cùm utilitatem, quod tu affatim doces,

page.notes: The catchword "P re" is spaced across the foot of the page; the second word is uncertain. The large initial C is joined to "Um" as "CUm". Hyphens at line ends are printed hyphens. Heading levels for the title and dedication lines are judgements based on their italic, centred setting.
